title: The Eternal Empire
subtitle: 1 IC – 1336 IC — From glory to the Great Cataclysm

cards.title: Foundation — Imperialus Conceptus (1 IC)
cards.text: The Azmeri left the mountains. Tarcus Veruso founded Sarn. The Phrecian dynasty (35 IC) became the royal line. The Empire expanded through conquest — enslaving the Ezomyte, Maraketh, and Karui.
cards.flavorText: "A strong leader can bridge the gap between survival and extinction." — Izaro Phrecius

cards.title: Emperor Izaro & The Labyrinth
cards.text: Izaro Phrecius created the Labyrinth — inspired by the Azmeri Lord's Trial. The Perandus family betrayed Izaro, trapping him in the Labyrinth forever. The Perandus family — Chitus, Cadiro — seized power through wealth and conspiracy.
cards.flavorText: "An Emperor does not sit on the throne. An Emperor IS the throne." — Izaro Phrecius

cards.title: Malachai & Thaumatocracy (1319-1334 IC)
cards.text: Emperor Chitus appointed Malachai — master thaumaturgist. Malachai industrialized Virtue Gem mining, created Gemling Legionnaires (soldiers with gems fused into their bones). Turned Lady Dialla into the "Gemling Queen" — a tortured immortal experiment.
cards.quote: "Studying Virtue Gems is the most dangerous task — gems whisper to their wielders." — Malachai
cards.flavorText: "Not a cockroach. Not yet." — Lady Dialla

cards.title: The Godless Three
cards.text: Malachai's three cruelest apprentices: Shavronne of Umbra — who created Brutus from a prisoner; Inquisitor Maligaro — the "anatomist" who turned humans into monsters; Doedre Darktongue Stamatis — the fallen witch.
cards.flavorText: "Progress is not made by the many." — Piety

cards.title: Purity Rebellion (1332-1334 IC)
cards.text: High Templar Voll led the uprising. Alliance: King Kaom (Karui — 20,000 warriors), Hyrri (Karui female archer), Deshret (Maraketh), Rigwald (Ezomyte). Voll defeated Chitus but spared Malachai — a fatal mistake.
cards.flavorText: "Victory is not in the Karui fist, it is in the Karui blood." — Kaom's Heart

cards.title: The Cataclysm (1336 IC)
cards.text: Malachai built the Rapture Device, resurrected the Godless Three, and breached The Beast. The Cataclysm destroyed the Empire. Sarn flooded with Undying. Kaom was trapped in the Nightmare. Hyrri became a wanderer. Deshret was sealed. Rigwald became the Greatwolf.
cards.warning: Malachai lives inside The Beast, becoming The Nightmare's Heart.
cards.flavorText: "Progress is not made by the many, but by those who dare step into the darkness." — Malachai

rows: Became part of Nightmare — Act 4 Boss
Lived 200+ years, refused to power Rapture Device
Became a wanderer, changed Karui women's roles
Spirit sealed in Mines — Act 4 quest
Died in Cataclysm, became Undying King
Act 1 Boss — cursed by Star of Wraeclast
